input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 gives Garman ownership of all IP in the Work "including any Improvements or Modifications thereto". "Modifications" are the bespoke changes set out in Schedule "D" that we commission and pay for (Sections 1(f), 4 and the Fee Schedule), so as drafted Garman owns the deliverables created for us, and because the Section 2 licence covers only the "Software" and "Documentation" (Schedules "B") there is not even a clear licence back to the Modifications. The agreement is also silent on ownership of our data, which Garman converts and processes under Section 4(b) — nothing confirms we retain all rights in it. Garman retaining ownership of its own routing platform is acceptable, so the redline leaves that intact and only (i) assigns customer-funded Modifications and deliverables to us with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back for any embedded Garman pre-existing IP, (ii) confirms our data and materials remain ours, and (iii) excludes joint ownership. Fallback offered in the comment is Garman ownership plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Modifications.

ops.newText: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. Except as expressly set out in this Section 13, no title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement. Garman hereby assigns to Sparkling all intellectual property rights in the Modifications and any other deliverables developed specifically for Sparkling and paid for by Sparkling, excluding any Garman intellectual property existing prior to or developed independently of this Agreement that is embedded therein, in respect of which Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such embedded Garman intellectual property as part of the Modifications and such deliverables for the purposes of Sparkling's business. Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data and materials, including all data converted, processed or stored using the Software, and Garman acquires no rights in them. Nothing in this Agreement creates joint ownership of any intellectual property.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have carved the bespoke Schedule "D" Modifications and any other deliverables we pay for out of Garman's blanket ownership claim, with a perpetual royalty-free licence back for any embedded Garman IP, and confirmed that our data remains ours. Our playbook position is that we own what we pay for and everything we put in; if assignment is not workable we can instead accept Garman ownership of the Modifications coupled with a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense them for our business.
proposal.summary: Limit Garman's IP ownership to its own pre-existing Work, assign customer-funded Modifications/deliverables to Sparkling with a licence back for embedded Garman IP, confirm Sparkling retains all rights in its data, and bar joint ownership.
